verdict.rationale: PostHog documents built-in AI capabilities beyond MCP-client tooling: PostHog AI can write Hog functions for CDP pipelines (docs-28), auto-open draft PRs for obvious code changes like removing dead flags (docs-32), and turn product signals into researched reports and PRs a user reviews and merges (gh-1). These indicate a real built-in assistant a user can delegate tasks to, not just an MCP interface for external agents. Missing for 10: a dedicated named-assistant doc page describing scope/limits, independent hands-on confirmation of these agentic PR/report features working, and clarity on how broadly delegation extends across the product.
